name: Draftpad default
code:
sheet({title:'Spindexer, 4 pockets', units:'mm'})
// everything on the plate is a child of this part, so one rotation turns it all
let sp = part({pivot:[0,0,0]})
cyl(0,0,0, 125,6, {axis:'z', fill:C.alu, part:sp})            // Ø250 plate
for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
  let a=i*Math.PI/2+Math.PI/4, x=74.8*Math.cos(a), y=74.8*Math.sin(a)
  cyl(x,y,6, 30,1, {axis:'z', fill:C.dark, part:sp})           // Ø60 cup at R 74.8
  box(0,-2,6, 120,4,66, {fill:C.alu, pivot:[0,0,6], part:sp}).rot[2]=i*90
}
let q=74.8*Math.SQRT1_2
sphere(q,-q,6+45.5, 45.5, {fill:C.red, part:sp})              // nectar, front pocket
sphere(q,q,6+35.5, 35.5, {fill:C.yellow, part:sp})            // pollen
cyl(0,0,-20, 16,20, {axis:'z', fill:C.dark})                   // servo stub
dim([-125,0,0],[125,0,0],{off:120,text:'Ø250 (9.85 in)'})
dim([0,-125,6],[0,-125,72],{off:60})
leader([-q,-q,8],'Ø60 cup',-50,-60)
const rpm=40
animate(t => { sp.rot[2] = t*rpm*6 })   // 6 deg per second per rpm
